title: assert_identifier's list of devbin's own variables is stale, so project.root_var can overwrite the run id, stamp, task and referent
body:
## Summary

**`assert_identifier` refuses a config value that names one of devbin's own environment variables, but its list stops short of what the runtime exports. So `project.root_var` can name a devbin variable the list omits, and bin/devbin:467 overwrites that variable with the project root.**

`assert_identifier` (lib/helpers) guards the config values devbin turns into variable names: `project.root_var`, `options.<name>.export`, and the `<NAME>_ROOT` derived from `project.name`. Its devbin-own case enumerates 15 names, by design: a `DEVBIN_*` wildcard refused devbin's own derived `DEVBIN_ROOT`. Read against every `export` in bin/devbin and lib/, the runtime also exports six names the list does not hold, and one dynamic family:

- `DEVBIN_RUN_ID` and `DEVBIN_RUN_STAMP` (bin/devbin:413)
- `DEVBIN_RUN_REFERENT` (bin/devbin:323, when `project.referent` is declared)
- `DEVBIN_CLI_TASK` (bin/devbin:434)
- `DEVBIN_LANGUAGES` (bin/devbin:495)
- `DEVBIN_FMT_ARMS` (bin/devbin:520)
- `DEVBIN_ACTIVE_<CMD>` for check, clean, db, docs, fmt and test (bin/devbin:607)

A guard whose population is a hand-kept copy of another file's exports drifts every time an export is added, and nothing reports it: the list refuses what it holds and passes the rest in silence.

## Measured

Driven through the real dispatcher on 2026-09-17 by vc, in a `git archive` export of c260eec, whose lib/, tests/ and bin/ are f34753f's: one fixture project per value, and a project handler printing the variables.

| `project.root_var`    | exit | what the project handler saw                             |
| --------------------- | ---- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| (not set)             | 0    | `DEVBIN_RUN_ID=afcbc440`, `DEMO_ROOT=<project root>`     |
| `DEMO_ROOT`           | 0    | every value intact                                       |
| `DEVBIN_RUN_ID`       | 0    | `DEVBIN_RUN_ID=<project root>`                           |
| `DEVBIN_RUN_STAMP`    | 0    | `DEVBIN_RUN_STAMP=<project root>`                        |
| `DEVBIN_CLI_TASK`     | 0    | `DEVBIN_CLI_TASK=<project root>`                         |
| `DEVBIN_RUN_REFERENT` | 0    | `DEVBIN_RUN_REFERENT=<project root>`                     |
| `DEVBIN_LIB`          | 1    | refused: "that name belongs to devbin's own environment" |

The last row is the control: the guard works for the names it holds.

Not yet driven: `options.<name>.export` into the same names (lib/resolve:1172), and what a path-valued `DEVBIN_RUN_STAMP` or `DEVBIN_RUN_ID` does to a gate's run log. `DEVBIN_LANGUAGES` and `DEVBIN_FMT_ARMS` are exported after line 467, so a `root_var` naming them is overwritten back; an option export happens later still, and would not be.

## The shape of a fix

- Add the missing names to the devbin-own case.
- **And an arm that holds the list against the dispatcher's real exports**, so the next export cannot reopen it: a project handler dumps its environment, every variable the dispatcher added (the handler's environment minus the caller's) is collected, and each must be refused by `assert_identifier`. A longer list without that arm is the same defect one export later.
- ST0007 WP-02 adds `DEVBIN_ROOT_VAR` (the root variable's name) to bin/devbin and to this list, with its own arm; its env-dump arm, which runs a notes command through the real dispatcher, is the shape to reuse.

## Arms a fix needs

- `project.root_var` and `options.<name>.export` naming each of the names above are refused, naming the value.
- The export-set arm goes red when bin/devbin gains an export that has not joined the list (mutant: an extra `export DEVBIN_PROBE=1`).

## Routing (hv, 2026-09-17)

- **dc builds, and vc reviews**, ruled by hv in vc's session on vc's proposal. dc builds it together with 0084, since both change lib/helpers, and dc added DEVBIN_ROOT_VAR to this list and built the env-dump arm a fix should reuse. vc found and measured it, so vc's review re-drives the probe and tries the mutations the arms above name.

## Fixed 2026-09-17 -- assert_identifier refuses every name the dispatcher exports, and an arm holds the list to what four paths receive (dc), reviewed by vc

**Commits:**
- `5e7fce5`: the fix, built with 0084.
- `8ef56c6`: the 0.1.2 note's Fixed entry, with CHANGELOG.md regenerated.
- `6608146`: vc's review folded. F1: the note's sentence was wrong for two of the six names, and now says what was measured. F4: the export-set arm reads a `notes.run` command's environment as a fourth source.

**What changed.**
- `assert_identifier`'s devbin-own case gains `DEVBIN_RUN_ID`, `DEVBIN_RUN_STAMP`, `DEVBIN_RUN_REFERENT`, `DEVBIN_CLI_TASK`, `DEVBIN_LANGUAGES`, `DEVBIN_FMT_ARMS` and the `DEVBIN_ACTIVE_*` family. `DEVBIN_TREEINDEX_DIRS` leaves it, since its export went with 0032.
- `project.root_var` and `options.<name>.export` naming any of them exit 1, naming the value.

**What it did before, measured at d6cb655** by dc and by vc, each through the dispatcher. This answers the "Not yet driven" line above.
- A `root_var` naming `DEVBIN_RUN_ID`, `DEVBIN_RUN_STAMP`, `DEVBIN_RUN_REFERENT` or `DEVBIN_CLI_TASK` put the project root in that variable at exit 0.
- A `root_var` naming `DEVBIN_LANGUAGES` or `DEVBIN_FMT_ARMS` got devbin's value instead (`shell`, and empty), so the root variable lost the root.
- An option exporting into any of the six put its own value there at exit 0.

**Arms, tests/unit/review.bats.**
- The `root_var` loop and the `options.style.export` loop each refuse the new names, naming the value.
- "R3: every name the dispatcher exports to a handler is one a config value may not take": runs started with only HOME and PATH, along four paths -- a project handler with `project.referent` declared, an option's `run:` through the gate, `test all`, and a `notes.run` command under `release check`. Every name they add but the project's own root variable must be refused, and controls show each path was reached. Not reached: `DEVBIN_OPT_<NAME>`, reserved as a family.

**Verified.**
- Red at d6cb655 for the defect: both loops accept `DEVBIN_RUN_ID`, and the export-set arm names the missing names.
- Mutants killed at their arms: `export DEVBIN_PROBE=1` in bin/devbin (the mutant this issue names), `DEVBIN_RUN_ID` dropped and `DEVBIN_ACTIVE_*` dropped (dc); `DEVBIN_LANGUAGES` dropped (vc's R4); `DEVBIN_PROBE_NOTES=1` in `_notes_command_env`'s export (vc's R6, which survived until `6608146`).
- The full suite at 5e7fce5's tree: 1..1328, 1328 ok, the 3 standing skips. vc's full suite at 6a48024 carried these arms: 1335/1335. At `6608146`, review.bats 25/25, run whole by dc and by vc, with lib/ unchanged since 6a48024.
- vc's static census: every name bin/devbin, lib/resolve and lib/release.notes export is on the list, apart from the project's own root variable and an option's own target.

**The limit.** Names devbin reads but does not export, such as `RUNLOG_KEEP_RUNS` and `DEVBIN_NO_UPDATE_NOTICE`, are not reserved: an option exporting into one is a way to set it.
